usedFor: Shopify shoppers who stop at checkout become tagged contacts in RD Station.

bestTemplate.name: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify, then “Create or Update Contact” in RD Station
bestTemplate.why: RD Station matches on the email or phone, so a returning shopper is not duplicated.

watchOut: “Create or Update Contact” works from the email, so a phone-only checkout has nothing to match.
